verdict.rationale: The app has a Library in Settings for adding skills and MCP servers, and every model can use those tools. That is a plausible route for bringing third-party integrations into the agent's workflow. The evidence never describes a partner-built agent-app ecosystem, marketplace, or vetting, so this only partly matches the story. Missing for 10: an explicit third-party or partner agent app catalog, documentation of how partner-built apps are packaged and installed into workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Library integration.
